# Protocol Traceability

<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:traceability`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every requirement in `protocol/requirements.yaml` (COLP 0.1) and `protocol/requirements-0.2.yaml`
(COLP 0.2 additions) is listed below with the package modules that implement it and the test IDs
that verify it. A test carries an ID by including `[evidence:<test-id>]` in its `describe` or `it`
name. "Verified" means every listed test passed in the last `npm run refresh:evidence` run.
The bundled `evidence.json` covers COLP 0.1 only; the 0.2 additions run in the same test suite
and are marked "Not bundled".
